name: Texture-object image rotation (linear filter, wrap addressing)
description: Rotate an image by sampling a texture object with normalized coordinates, bilinear filtering and wrap addressing.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: transformKernel and the full texture-object setup (channel desc, cudaArray, resource/texture descriptors, cudaCreateTextureObject) verbatim; deterministic smooth image replaces the PGM input; tolerance covers the 9-bit interpolation-weight quantization.
notes: Texture-object API previously uncovered; SYCL maps to images/samplers.
